blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب الجمعة في القري والمدن. رقم:٨٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “All of you are responsible, and each of you will be questioned (about those under him). The ruler is responsible and will be questioned about his subjects. The head of the family is responsible for his household and will be questioned about his household. A woman is responsible for her husband's house and will be questioned about the children and others living in that house. A servant is responsible for his master's property and will be questioned about his master's belongings and wealth. A son is responsible for his father's property and will be questioned about his father's property. Each of you is responsible, and each will be questioned about those under him,” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) has narrated that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا يَسْتَرْعِي اللهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي عَبْدًا رَعِيَّةً قَلَّتْ أَوْ كَثُرَتْ إِلَّا سَأَلَهُ اللهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي عَنْهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَقَامَ فِيهِمْ أَمْرَ اللهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي أَمْ أَضَاعَهُ حَتَّي يَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ خَاصَّةً.
blocks.tamil_translation: “When Allah Ta'ala makes someone responsible, whether those under him are few or many, Allah Ta'ala will certainly question him on the Day of Qiyamah whether he safeguarded the command of Allah Ta'ala in that responsibility of his or wasted it; in particular, He will question him about his household,” Rasulullah
